colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element pictures. Picture 2 is the empty cozy living room of Nan: warm cream walls, a light wooden floor, a blue sofa with one cushion and a folded blanket on its arm, a big round soft rug, a wooden toy box with a few toys at the right, and a small window at the left; use it as the background and keep the same room. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The doll Pam: a small rag doll with short bright yellow yarn hair (a fringe and two short yarn bunches), a round cream cloth face with two round black button eyes, a small stitched smile, and a simple red dress with short sleeves. The picture: Pam, the doll, is the MAIN thing in the picture. A close shot at the camera height of the doll. The doll stands ALONE in the MIDDLE of the picture, large: the whole doll from the top of her yarn hair to her feet is in view, and she takes up about two thirds of the picture height. Her round cloth face with its two button eyes is big enough to read at book size. NO PERSON IS IN THE PICTURE: there is no girl, no child, no Nan, no hand, and no arm. The doll stands on the big round soft rug of picture 2, and the blue sofa, the toy box, and the window of picture 2 stay behind her, soft and simple. Exactly ONE figure: the doll. The doll has no eyes of her own other than her two round black button eyes, and no text on her dress. The page text is "This is Pam." and is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G. The doll is alone: no person and no hand anywhere in the picture. THE DOLL IS THE MAIN THING: the doll is large and in the middle of the picture, and the room behind her is soft and out of focus. The doll is not small, not in a bag, and not held by anybody.
